root.description: The id of the root the path is under

path.description: The file the condition is about (a package.json, pnpm-workspace.yaml), relative to its root; `.` for the analysis root itself

code.description: `WORKSPACE_MEMBER_NO_ROWS`: a member's package.json has no rows this run, so its name, version and dependencies are unknown; `WORKSPACE_MEMBER_EXCLUDED`: a member's package.json is routed away from the data instance (an exclude), so its name, version and dependencies are unknown; `WORKSPACE_TARGET_UNKNOWN`: some member's name is unknown (WORKSPACE_MEMBER_NO_ROWS or WORKSPACE_MEMBER_EXCLUDED), so every name match in the root is uncertain: a dependency with targetPath null may name one of them, and one matched to a member may too, since a name may be shared; a unique match is still picked. One per root, naming those members, at the root package.json (`.` when the run holds none); `WORKSPACE_DUPLICATE_NAME`: two members a dependency's name can reach carry one name (npm's folder name for a member with none included; the root only where a name reaches it beside a member, so never under bun, npm or yarn 1), at each of them; a dependency that names it by name has targetPath null; `WORKSPACE_PATH_UNRESOLVED`: a `workspace:`, `file:`, `link:` or bare path names no member's directory (a tarball, a directory outside the workspace, an absolute or home path, one leaving the analysis root), is a `workspace:` path under a manager with no path form, or is bun's `link:<package name>`, which names a package registered with `bun link` rather than a directory; targetPath is null; `WORKSPACE_PACKAGES_MALFORMED`: the member pattern list is not an array of strings, or pnpm refuses the file for a missing `packages`; VAT reads what it can and says so; `WORKSPACE_ROOT_REFUSED`: this root's workspace rows are refused (the message leads with the refusal code) while other roots answer; the root has no package or dependency rows; `WORKSPACE_ROOT_MAY_BE_ABOVE`: the analysis root declares no workspace, holds a package.json and sits below its repository's top level, so a workspace above it may hold its packages; path is `.`; `WORKSPACE_ROOT_OUTSIDE_ROOT`: a package.json under an analysis root that declares no workspace declares a `workspace:` dependency, so its workspace root may lie above the analysis root; at that package.json; `WORKSPACE_NOT_DECLARED`: the manager reads no workspace at the root although one may be meant: yarn 1 and a root package.json listing at least one workspace package whose private field is not truthy (at the root package.json), or pnpm with no pnpm-workspace.yaml and a package.json under the root declaring a `workspace:` dependency (at that package.json); `WORKSPACE_MANAGER_INFERRED`: the root names no packageManager (or yarn without a version), and VAT read the manager from which files exist at the root, never their content; the message names them and what the inference decided; at the root package.json (`.` when the run holds none); `WORKSPACE_MANAGER_UNKNOWN`: the manager is unknown (no packageManager and no lockfile or several managers' lockfiles, yarn of unknown flavour, or a manager VAT does not know; at the root package.json, `.` when the run holds none), or a dependency whose target depends on it: the root package's name, a nameless member's folder name, a `workspace:` path, a bare path the managers read differently, or `link:<package name>` (at the member, targetPath null); `WORKSPACE_MANAGER_VERSION_UNKNOWN`: pnpm-workspace.yaml has no packages key, whose meaning pnpm changed at 10.5.0, and the pnpm version is unknown; VAT reads the root only; at the root package.json (`.` when the run holds none); `WORKSPACE_MEMBER_NAMELESS`: a member with rows has no name (absent, empty or not a string) under a manager that names no member by its folder, so no dependency can name it by name; under an unknown manager the message says npm would name it by its folder; `WORKSPACE_READ_AS_JSONC`: a package.json the step read is routed as `jsonc` (a jsonc rule), and package managers parse package.json as strict JSON, so a comment or trailing comma VAT accepts would fail every manager; once per manifest
